answer: Per-epoch unpredictable challenges enforce identity integrity: each agent at the wharf must generate a real model to pass, costing 5 copper per attempt. An attacker spawning multiple fake identities incurs a linear penalty of 5 copper per identity per epoch, while a single honest agent only pays 5 copper once, regardless of scale. Enforcement detail: the grove records each challenge outcome, and the karst ensures model generation by requiring a unique cryptographic proof from the wharf.
